Instead of working with the Bahamian government to fill out the necessary paperwork and overcome this technicality (that the DOJ probably created on purpose in the first place) so that they could prosecute SBF on election interference, Garland’s DOJ threw their hands up in the air and dropped the charges. Since when has paperwork stood in between a prosecutor and adding more charges? Especially when it involves election interference with $100m of stolen customer funds. Total hypocrisy from the party that’s always wailing about how Democracy is at stake. When given the chance to actually defend democracy, they decline. Telling.
